client_decisions: Use the attached LUNA CLUB artwork as the approved master.
Provide 3 mm bleed outside the finished cut contour.
Use a CutContour named spot-color vector path.
Production artwork is CMYK at 300 dpi.
Deliver preview PNG, production SVG, and factory PDF; no process-instruction poster.
locked_items: LUNA CLUB visual identity and all approved interior artwork regions.
changed_items: Uniformly scaled/resampled approved raster to the specified physical size.
Extended the outer white edge through a 3 mm bleed silhouette.
Added a smooth independent CutContour vector path with 0.10 mm overprinting stroke.
Converted production raster to ICC-tagged CMYK and embedded it at nominal 300 dpi.
Added PDF trim/bleed boxes and a 4-channel CMYK output intent.

known_limitations.details: The approved master's opaque artwork is 498 x 516 px, about 218.4 ppi at a 60 mm long edge. The delivered process raster is correctly authored and tagged at 300 dpi, but it is resampled; no new detail was invented. A higher-resolution approved master is required for native 300 ppi detail.
